biggest_catch: Every same-day cashout costs a fee, and new debit cards sit in a 48-hour review before Express Pay works at all.
catches: Express Pay costs $1.25–$1.75 per transfer (Lyft's own pages differ; current help says $1.25, min $6.25; driver blog says $1.75, min $6.75) — check your app's current terms.
48-hour delay after adding or changing your Express Pay card before you can cash out.
Up to 5 cashouts per 24 hours; some banks need an extra business day for deposits to appear.
Unpaid when you cash out early: anything not cashed out waits for the weekly Tuesday deposit.
Express Pay unavailable if you have rides in review or wage garnishment.

c1.evidence: Official Lyft driver blog (lyft.com/hub/posts/express-pay): 'Express Pay makes it easier to fund life outside of the driver's seat. It's a first-of-its-kind feature that provides instant access to cash out whenever you want.'

c2.evidence: Official Lyft: per-ride fares shown in the Driver app; amounts vary per ride. Express Pay cashes out 'your earnings anytime.' No fixed official per-ride range.

c3.evidence: No fee to sign up; Express Pay fee is per-transfer ($1.25–$1.75 per Lyft's own pages), not upfront.

c4.evidence: Official Lyft help: 'You can use Express Pay to cash out your earnings anytime. Earnings can appear within a few hours or days, depending on your bank's processing time... You can cash out your earnings up to five times every 24 hours.' Same-day cashout confirmed.

steps: Sign up to drive with Lyft (eligible car, insurance, background check).
Set up Express Pay: add your debit card in Account > Pay and Tax Info (48-hour review for new cards).
Go online and complete rides; fares + tips accrue in your earnings.
Tap Cash out on the Earnings screen — up to 5 times per 24 hours.
Earnings land via push-to-debit (usually within hours; some banks need a business day).
timing: Express Pay: cash out anytime up to 5x/day (~$1.25–$1.75 fee), earnings appear within hours to a day depending on bank. Default weekly deposit on Tuesdays is free.
who_pays: Lyft pays you per ride — fares plus bonuses plus tips; the free default payout is a weekly Tuesday deposit.
who_qualifies: 21+ for rideshare (region-dependent); an eligible car plus insurance; a background check; a debit card for Express Pay.
work_available: Open once you're approved — go online and take rides; demand varies by market and time of day.
what_gets_accepted: Rides pay the offered fare. Express Pay is unavailable if you have rides in review or a wage garnishment.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: waiting between rides, plus the background check and approval process. Your vehicle costs are yours. Express Pay costs about $1.25–$1.75 per transfer (Lyft's own pages differ — check your app's current terms).
when_cash_arrives: Express Pay: cash out up to 5 times a day, with earnings appearing within hours to a day depending on your bank (new cards sit in a 48-hour review first). The free weekly deposit lands on Tuesdays.

repeatable.cadence: Drive whenever you want — each ride earns, cash out up to 5x a day with Express Pay, and keep driving.
